t: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉被刺杀,由他的普拉托里安卫队都督马库斯·奥佩利乌斯·麦克里努斯接任.
te: Roman emperor Caracalla is assassinated and is succeeded by his Praetorian Guard prefect, Marcus Opellius Macrinus.
